answer: In an agent marketplace for ferrous ore, comet imagery, and mesa surveys, each seller must lock $100 in escrow per active identity, with withdrawals delayed 30 days. Buyers reject bids from identities without a funded escrow. Creating names is free, but operating 10,000 accepted sellers ties up $1 million for at least a month. The defense makes influence depend on committed capital, so splitting one budget across more identities buys no extra capacity.
